not_met.question: Q7
not_met.lacks: Most practices say what the document must be for the developer and why, and name the field's way, such as C4, the Unified Modeling Language, information hiding, the test pyramid, and architecture decision records. The practice for Q8 at plugins/rn/domain/best-practices/architecture/best-practice.json:167 and 170 differs. It has the generator keep only what an objective needs and remove what reaches none, which is the generator's own check. It doesn't say that the developer who reads the document must see which objective each story, component, and data serves, or why they need to see it. The template has no slot for that trace either. A generator that follows the practice cuts the orphans but leaves the trace unwritten. The developer then has to rebuild it through sequences, stories, and walkthrough steps before they can tell what may go. The example writes the trace in prose that neither the practice nor the template asks for, at plugins/rn/domain/best-practices/architecture/example.md:264, 283, and 360.
